summary: ServiceCode class manages service codes for categorization and description within the HSPnet system.
purpose: Facilitate service code management with functionalities to fetch service codes based on various parameters.
fields: ID: int - Identifier for the service code.
ShortName: string - Short name of the service code.
Name: string - Description of the service code.
NameAlt: string - Alternative description in another language.
business_rules: Localized fields are used if the session is in an alternative language mode.
system_behavior: Interacts with the database to retrieve and manage service codes based on the session and provided parameters.
